So the overall order is roughly:

Cara and Gus have exactly one person between them. Since Finn is immediately before Gus, if Cara is at position p, Gus at p+2 means Finn at p+1. That works: Cara, Finn, Gus with exactly one person (Finn) between Cara and Gus.

So the sequence becomes:
Hana, Ann, Dev, Ben, Cara, Finn, Gus, Elif, Ivo
